units.source_text: 姐姐，明天你就到大阪生活了。

en.t: Big sister, tomorrow you will start living in Osaka.

units.source_text: 但是，恳求你不要忘记妹妹照子。

en.t: But I beg you, please do not forget your younger sister Teruko.

units.source_text: 我每天早上喂鸡的时候，都会因为想到姐姐而流泪……

en.t: Every morning when I feed the chickens, I think of you and end up crying...
